== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The term Irons refers to several distinct concepts within the world. Primarily, it identifies a specific rank or class of individuals, often appearing as combatants or reinforcements who utilize various weapons such as spears. These individuals may possess varying levels of spiritual ability, with some lacking significant spirit-sense{{!}}spiritual sense while others use techniques involving light or fire. In terms of progression, the term is used to describe a stage of development for humans that sits above the [[Copper]] rank. Additionally, Irons refers to various types of specialized physical enhancements known as [[Iron]] bodies. These corporeal augmentations provide different benefits depending on their specific type: the Steelborn body{{!}}Steelborn Iron body offers immense strength but requires constant fuel to prevent injury; the [[Moonheart Iron body]] was adopted by a royal family to compensate for specific weaknesses; and the [[Silverscale Iron body]] provides resistance against spiritual attacks, a feature commonly used by fishermen to endure [[madra]]-based attacks from sea creatures. Finally, the term can relate to materials and objects, such as [[wintersteel]] ore or mechanical [[constructs]] made of [[steel]] and brass.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The Irons are a group of armed combatants belonging to the [[Wei clan]] who reside at [[Mount Samara]]. While initially observed hiding within the branches of a tree, they are established as enemies of [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]]. During later events, [[Mercy]] managed to gather a force consisting of over two hundred Irons.}}
